title: Assessment of COVID-19’s Impact on Low-income and Other Vulnerable Persons and Households
what_it_is: Assessment of COVID-19’s Impact on Low-income and Other Vulnerable Persons and Households

sections.label: Essential services continue with precautions
sections.summary: Essential services like Social Service Offices, senior care centres, residential and home-based care, and community mental health services will continue supporting clients with precautionary measures.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
sentences.text: First, I would like to assure Members that the essential services such as the Social Service Offices (SSOs), selected senior care centres, residential and home-based care services, and community mental health services will continue to provide support for their clients, with precautionary measures in place.

sections.label: SSOs contact quarantined ComCare clients
sections.summary: SSOs proactively contact past and present ComCare clients issued Quarantine Orders or Stay-Home Notices to check financial assistance needs and facilitate applications.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
sentences.text: Our SSOs proactively contact past and present ComCare clients who have been issued Quarantine Orders or Stay-Home Notices to see if they require any financial assistance, and facilitate their applications where needed.

sections.label: COVID-19 Support Grant and ComCare flexibility
sections.summary: New COVID-19 Support Grant, relief for self-employed persons and longer ComCare assistance for lower income workers will benefit those needing more help.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
sentences.text: Those who require more help this period will benefit more.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
sentences.text: This includes the new COVID-19 Support Grant for those who have lost their jobs due to the crisis, relief for self-employed persons and additional flexibility for ComCare, such as providing a longer duration of assistance to lower income workers.

sections.label: NTUC Care Fund cash relief
sections.summary: The NTUC Care Fund announced a scheme providing up to $300 one-off cash relief for union members who lost income due to the outbreak.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
sentences.text: The NTUC Care Fund has announced a scheme to provide up to $300 in one-off cash relief for their union members who have lost income due to the outbreak.

sections.label: National CARE hotline and essential services
sections.summary: A National CARE hotline will let anyone call for support from psychologists and counsellors, with referrals to specialist services, while social service agencies continue as essential services.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: As announced yesterday, we are going to set a National CARE hotline where anybody can call in to be supported by psychologists, counsellors and other people, and we then refer these people to specialist services to enable them to get the help they need and to get it early.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: Whilst we want to put in place safe distancing measures for the protection of the vulnerable individuals as well as our social sector professionals, these social service agencies, together with Adult Protective Service and Child Protective Service, they continue to function as essential services; and we will make sure that they are adequately resourced during this time.

sections.label: Funding and schemes for SSAs
sections.summary: Funding was announced for each SSA for BCP, cleaning and sanitation, with existing schemes like VCF and extended Bicentennial Fund co-matching supporting them during the crisis.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: Early on in this crisis, we had announced the funding for each SSA to help them with BCP, help them with cleaning and sanitation support, and to help them in other areas.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: We are bringing to the fore many of the existing schemes, such as the VWOs-Charities Capability Fund (VCF) as well as other schemes, that enable our SSAs to put in place the mechanisms, to bring in the technology and the skills, to be able to continue to support vulnerable Singaporeans during this crisis, but in the climate where safe distancing needs to be respected.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: We extended the Bicentennial Fund co-matching beyond the March timeline to enable SSAs to continue to benefit from co-funding.
